core.notes:
Modules save to your browser at most once every 10 seconds while you play (some saved every 2), and still save the moment you close the tab
A stuck update check now gives up after 20 seconds, so Check works again
Profile Sync: the last action's gold is described as after village tax
Profile Sync now records your village rank's tax rates (Village Taxes: experience, gold and relics per activity, and partner resources), read the way the village Ranks page reads them, and only while you are in a village
Tools: hover pop-ups open centred over what you point at and stay inside the window, instead of sometimes opening to the right as a thin column or hanging off the bottom
Cost Tables: the village boss base prices now come from the game data, the pet note says pets keep adding 6% a level past 150, the footer says checked against 1.2.3.13, and Fighter slots notes the game's Toggle Fighter Gold switch
The AWOO+ menu now shows up even with no module installed, and says "No modules installed."
If AWOO+ itself fails to start, a small "AWOO+ failed to start" notice shows the error instead of nothing appearing
Until AWOO+ has read the game's number setting, numbers like "1,234" or "1.234" are left alone instead of guessed from your browser's language, and Appearance › Numbers asks you to pick one
Profile Sync: a section that came back empty now says "came back empty" instead of showing as fresh
Profile data: a date from another year shows its year, and numbers with decimals get thousands separators (25.727,9)
Profile data and Profile Sync now count sections the same way: "20 of 21 fresh, 1 old but unused"
Profile data opened from the Control Panel with "Keep on top" opens in front of the panel, not behind it
Profile data: a wide table scrolls inside its own card instead of making the whole window scroll sideways
Notices set to "Beside the menu" now appear below the top bar instead of over its buttons
Profile Sync card: the ticking "synced 5s ago" time has a fixed width, so nothing around it shifts
AWOO+ now tells you when your browser storage is full or blocked and it cannot save its settings, module list or profile (one notice per session, details in Diagnostics)
Fixed: after a pet swap, Profile Sync could put your gold and income boosts back to what they were when the page loaded
Fixed: diagnostics recorded while a check-in was being sent were thrown away; they now go with the next one
Fixed: a newer copy of a module that needs a newer AWOO+ no longer stops the older copy that was working
Tabs no longer undo each other's settings; a theme or number change follows in every open tab, and a module loaded or unloaded in another tab shows a note with Reload
